svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tube 40 OD x 3 wall x 150 tall, closed at the top by a 2 mm plate

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with a 3 mm acoustic port on the axis.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drip skirt 64 OD, its top 58 below the port; 45 degree cone under

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: it so it prints without support. Spike boss on it, 26 off the axis.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Arm socket 33 OD, bore 25.4, 25 deep, its axis 120 below the port;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4.4 mm cross hole 12.5 in from its open end, top to bottom.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Inside: two card guides with 1.8 mm slots for the processor board;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: two 5 mm bosses under the top plate, 20 apart, for the mic board.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 3.2 mm holes 4 above the open end for the cap screws.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print standing on the top plate, supports under the arm socket only.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Press an M3 heat-set insert into the spike boss.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the port is clear; a 25 mm tube slides into the socket.
